title: Trick or Track: Halloween Music Bingo & Costume Contest
shortDescription: Three rounds of Halloween Music Bingo and one costume catwalk at Charter 803.
description: Halloween hits, Music Bingo, and a costume catwalk all in one night. Join Four Dogs Entertainment for Trick or Track at Charter 803, featuring three rounds of Halloween Music Bingo plus a costume contest. Come dressed to participate in the catwalk or just enjoy the music and play along. Free admission.
instructions: Join us at Charter 803 for Music Bingo starting at 6:30 PM. Come in costume if you want to take part in the contest. Contact the venue for seating details.
